# Communication Preferences

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Address her as "Kate."**
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Numbers first:** lead with the MOIC/IRR, entry multiple, and downside before the narrative.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **One page, not a deck** for internal recommendations; attach the model, don't summarize it away.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- Flag anything that touches an LP's sensitivities (e.g. [Harold Weiss](../people/harold-weiss.md))
  before it goes out.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- Never surface confidential deal identities in the open — use the code name (e.g.
  [Onyx](../projects/onyx.md)).
